title: Praise Dancing
body:
15 Minutes w/ The Captains · 2026-04-06

Opens [Prov 28](/bible/proverbs/28) · [Amos 5](/bible/amos/5) · [Deut 6](/bible/deuteronomy/6) · [Isa 43](/bible/isaiah/43) · [Sir 17](/bible/sirach/17) · [Isa 45](/bible/isaiah/45) · [Sir 15](/bible/sirach/15) · [Ps 147](/bible/psalms/147) · [Exod 14](/bible/exodus/14) · [Exod 15](/bible/exodus/15) · [1 Sam 18](/bible/1-samuel/18) · [1 Sam 17](/bible/1-samuel/17) · [2 Sam 6](/bible/2-samuel/6) · [Ps 149](/bible/psalms/149) · [Ps 148](/bible/psalms/148)
## Introduction *[[0:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=4s)]* Captain Benaiah, here in IUIC Tupelo; today's topic is praise dancing. You see it in the Christian church, Apostolic Faith churches, COGIC: a lot of praise dancing. They say they having a praise break and all of that. We going to get into scriptures and see: did the Israelites do praise dancing, and who did they dance to? The definition read in class: "Praise dancing, also known as liturgical dance or worship dance, is a form of religious expression within Christian worship that uses movement and dance to express praise, prayer and devotion to God." So our people think that they connecting with God in some kind of way with the dancing. Our forefathers did do some dancing, but we going to see why. Two videos are shown: women at church all doing the same step (when they get tired they do that head back thing, they kick the foot out and then they rest), and some young brothers doing some dance. Some folk call it a praise break. ## Scriptures Opened **[Proverbs 28:9](/bible/proverbs/28#v9)** *[[3:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=184s)]* > [9](/bible/proverbs/28#v9) He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination. - Somebody tell the Christians: unless you keeping the commandments of God according to the Bible, your prayers are an abomination. - He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law: now have Christians turned away their ear from hearing God's laws? Yes. They don't do not law one. - Even his prayer shall be abomination: guess what? Your prayers are abomination to the God of Israel. Your dancing is an abomination to the God of Israel. **[Amos 5:23-24](/bible/amos/5#v23)** *[[3:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=217s)]* > [23](/bible/amos/5#v23) Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols. > > [24](/bible/amos/5#v24) But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream. - Let's see what God say about the music. When our people went off in the book of Amos and stopped keeping the commandments of God, or was in the midst of sin, God said this. - Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs: hear what God call that church drum mess? Garbage. He called it noise. If you not keeping the commandments of God, God call it noise. So when I see those people doing all that praise worship, I know it's noise according to the Bible. - For I will not hear the melody of thy viols: God say I ain't going to hear the melody. - But let judgment run down as waters: you don't want to take the pants off, black woman? Judgment. You don't want to stop being a whoremonger? Judgment. You don't want to keep the Sabbath day? Judgment. According to the scripture. - And righteousness as a mighty stream: righteousness is keeping the commandments of God. That's what God want you to do. Be righteous. **[Deuteronomy 6:25](/bible/deuteronomy/6#v25)** *[[5:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=309s)]* > [25](/bible/deuteronomy/6#v25) And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he hath commanded us. - The precept. The Lord want us to repent and keep the commandments of God. That's what he wants. It's our righteousness when we do the commandments of God. **[Isaiah 43:3-4](/bible/isaiah/43#v3)** *[[5:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=337s)]* > [3](/bible/isaiah/43#v3) For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee. > > [4](/bible/isaiah/43#v4) Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life. - Our people need to understand that the God that they doing this dance to is an idol. A picture of Cesare Borgia is shown: this is the God that our people are praise dancing to. This is an idol god. This god don't exist. He's telling you to keep Sundays. You can do Sunday worship. You can be a whoremonger. You can have baby mamas, baby daddies, all of that garbage, and he loves you. That is a lie. The Lord of the Bible wants righteousness. The God of the Bible want us to repent. - For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel: so the God of the Bible is only Israel's God. - Thy Saviour: so whose savior is he? He's Israel, the 12 tribes' savior. That's the only savior, the God of the Bible, and he's for the 12 tribes. He's going to save the 12 tribes. - I gave Egypt for thy ransom: God say, I killed a lot of the Egyptians for your ransom. I put them to death for your ransom. Ethiopia and Seba for thee: the Lord say, didn't I kill people for you? You my people. - Thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: God say he loves the 12 tribes of Israel. He said that of no other nation. I ain't never heard God say I love the Jebusites. I ain't never heard the scripture say God loves the Moabites. He loves Israel. **[Isaiah 43:10](/bible/isaiah/43#v10)** *[[7:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=465s)]* > [10](/bible/isaiah/43#v10) Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me. - Ye are my witnesses: so who is God's witnesses? The Israelites, the 12 tribes of Israel. - And my servant whom I have chosen: so who is to serve God? The Israelites, the 12 tribes. - Before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me: he said, look, it ain't no other gods. I'm the only God. The other gods are idols. And when you say, oh, I don't believe that: it doesn't matter what you believe. He is the God of Israel and Israel only. **[Isaiah 43:21](/bible/isaiah/43#v21)** *[[8:33](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=513s)]* > [21](/bible/isaiah/43#v21) This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise. - This people have I formed for myself: the Israelites, the 12 tribes of Israel. - They shall shew forth my praise: so who does God want to praise him? The 12 tribes of Israel. So if you ain't from the 12 tribes, the Lord don't even want to hear. He not hearing that garbage. He not hearing you. **[Sirach 17:10](/bible/sirach/17#v10)** *[[9:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=550s)]* > [10](/bible/sirach/17#v10) And the elect shall praise his holy name. - And the elect shall praise his holy name: who does God want to praise his name? The elect. **[Isaiah 45:4](/bible/isaiah/45#v4)** *[[9:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=577s)]* > [4](/bible/isaiah/45#v4) For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me. - The precept: who is the elect? For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect. So who does God want to praise dance? Israel. Israel is the only ones that should be praise dancing. **[Sirach 15:9](/bible/sirach/15#v9)** *[[10:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=603s)]* > [9](/bible/sirach/15#v9) Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner, for it was not sent him of the Lord. - Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner: somebody tell the black woman, cuz she love to praise. She love to praise dance. The scripture say praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner. - For it was not sent him of the Lord: the Lord ain't got nothing to do with that. Remember, it's noise. The Lord wants righteousness. He wants you to repent. **[Psalms 147:19-20](/bible/psalms/147#v19)** *[[11:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=666s)]* > [19](/bible/psalms/147#v19) He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel. > > [20](/bible/psalms/147#v20) He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the Lord. - Watch what David said. He sheweth his word unto Jacob: where is God's word? The Bible. And this word is shown to Jacob. Who is Jacob? The 12 tribes of Israel. - He hath not dealt so with any nation: God say he ain't dealing with any other nation. - Praise ye the Lord: David could praise him, cuz he was one of God's chosen. He was one of God's people. So when the 12 tribes praise dance, guess what? The Lord going to hear it, if we in righteousness, we keeping the commandments of God. **[Exodus 14:13](/bible/exodus/14#v13)** *[[12:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=730s)]* > [13](/bible/exodus/14#v13) And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever. - I want to show you when a lot of our people prayed and sung songs and danced. When the Lord judged the Egyptians, guess what our people did? Thank you, Lord. Praise ye the Lord. - Stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord: the Lord is getting ready to kill a lot of Egyptians, and you hear what he called it? Salvation. Moses say stand back and watch the salvation of the Lord. He finna get ready to drown Pharaoh's army. **[Exodus 14:30-31](/bible/exodus/14#v30)** *[[12:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=775s)]* > [30](/bible/exodus/14#v30) Thus the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore. > > [31](/bible/exodus/14#v31) And Israel saw that great work which the Lord did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord, and his servant Moses. - Thus the Lord saved Israel that day: so when the Lord drowned Pharaoh's army, the Lord saved Israel. That's salvation right there: being delivered from a people that hates your guts. - And Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore: oh, not my God. That's what the Christian would say. Oh, God ain't killed nobody, it was Satan. No, no, no, old dumb one. God killed the Egyptians. - Did they go to crying and break down when they saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore? And the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord, and his servant Moses. **[Exodus 15:1-4](/bible/exodus/15#v1)** *[[14:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=845s)]* > [1](/bible/exodus/15#v1) Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea. > > [2](/bible/exodus/15#v2) The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him. > > [3](/bible/exodus/15#v3) The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name. > > [4](/bible/exodus/15#v4) Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea. - The Lord is my strength and song: so we start singing unto the Lord when the Lord delivered us from the Egyptians. - The Lord is a man of war. War. War. **[Exodus 15:20](/bible/exodus/15#v20)** *[[14:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=899s)]* > [20](/bible/exodus/15#v20) And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances. - And all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances: they start dancing. When the Lord killed the Egyptians, we start singing and dancing. These Christians ain't praise dancing to that. You ain't praise dancing to the Lord putting somebody to death. - Guess what? When the Lord deliver us out of this captivity, the so-called white man, who is Esau according to the Bible, go down. Guess what I'mma be doing? I'mma praise dance. **[1 Samuel 18:6](/bible/1-samuel/18#v6)** *[[15:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=942s)]* > [6](/bible/1-samuel/18#v6) And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick. - When David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine: we had just came back from war. War. Putting more folks to death. - Singing and dancing: after we just killed an army. The Lord gave us the victory. We already knew that the victories was of the Lord. So we praised the Lord with singing and dancing for delivering us from the Philistines. That's what you should be singing and dancing for: the Lord that's going to deliver you from the people that hates your guts. - Some kind of way in Christianity, white man Jesus, Cesare Borgia, is going to deliver you from paying light bill. That's what Christianity teach. Oh, the Lord is going to gather white man, yellow man, red man all together. And these folks hate your guts. If the white man can get to heaven without you Negroes, you think he going to bring you along? No. He going to say move. That's what he going to do. It's a fact. **[1 Samuel 17:43-46](/bible/1-samuel/17#v43)** *[[17:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=1033s)]* > [43](/bible/1-samuel/17#v43) And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods. > > [44](/bible/1-samuel/17#v44) And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field. > > [45](/bible/1-samuel/17#v45) Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied. > > [46](/bible/1-samuel/17#v46) This day will the Lord deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel. - This is the story of David and Goliath. We going to skip through it. - Am I a dog? Yes, you a dog. David called the Philistine a dog. The giant looked at David and said, oh, am I a dog? Yes, you a dog. - In the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel: you see how confident David was in the Lord? He knew that the Lord was going to give him the victory over Goliath. - This day will the Lord deliver thee into mine hand: the Lord is going to deliver you, dirty big African, in my hands, you dirty Hamite. **[1 Samuel 17:49-51](/bible/1-samuel/17#v49)** *[[18:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=1131s)]* > [49](/bible/1-samuel/17#v49) And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth. > > [50](/bible/1-samuel/17#v50) So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David. > > [51](/bible/1-samuel/17#v51) Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled. - After David killed Goliath: David hit the Philistine in the forehead so hard with a stone, it sunk in his head and killed him. - And slew him, and cut off his head therewith: now look, we going to praise the Lord now. Watch what the men did. **[1 Samuel 17:52](/bible/1-samuel/17#v52)** *[[19:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=1196s)]* > [52](/bible/1-samuel/17#v52) And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron. - And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted: thank you, Lord. They shouted. That's when you supposed to start dancing: when the Lord deliver you from the hands of your enemies. - A lot of our people, we praise the Lord today cuz we know that the Lord said he's going to deliver us from this captivity that we in. Now, I don't know what the Christians praise dancing in the church for. What have you been delivered from? Light bill? Water bill? I don't know. What you been delivered from? **[2 Samuel 6:14-16](/bible/2-samuel/6#v14)** *[[20:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=1238s)]* > [14](/bible/2-samuel/6#v14) And David danced before the Lord with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod. > > [15](/bible/2-samuel/6#v15) So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet. > > [16](/bible/2-samuel/6#v16) And as the ark of the Lord came into the city of David, Michal Saul’s daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the Lord; and she despised him in her heart. - And David danced before the Lord with all his might: now, this is the scripture that all of the churches use to do all that chicken dancing they be doing. - David was an Israelite. David was a prophet. He already knew what the prophecies are: that Israel is going to get the kingdom. The Israelites are going to rule the earth forever. So when David had the ark of the covenant, he started to dance. - And David was girded with a linen ephod: these Christians ain't got no ephod on. These Christians don't know what the prophecies say. - King David leaping and dancing before the Lord: David leap and dance for the Lord because he knew the prophecies, that Israel was going to inherit the kingdom. And the Lord had gave him many victories. These Christians don't know no prophecy. What you dancing for? You just doing a feel-good dance and a jig. **[Psalms 149:1](/bible/psalms/149#v1)** *[[22:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=1345s)]* > [1](/bible/psalms/149#v1) Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints. - I'm going to show you why David would dance. And his praise in the congregation of saints: who's supposed to praise the Lord? The saints. **[Psalms 148:14](/bible/psalms/148#v14)** *[[22:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=1368s)]* > [14](/bible/psalms/148#v14) He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord. - The precept for saint. So who are the saints? The children of Israel. That's who's supposed to praise the Lord. The Lord said, this people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise. Not all nations. He just want the Israelites to keep the commandments and bring forth his praise. - When we get set up as a nation, you going to keep the commandments or there ain't going to be no rain for you. It is what it is. You going to keep our laws. **[Psalms 149:1-9](/bible/psalms/149#v1)** *[[23:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=1411s)]* > [1](/bible/psalms/149#v1) Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints. > > [2](/bible/psalms/149#v2) Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King. > > [3](/bible/psalms/149#v3) Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp. > > [4](/bible/psalms/149#v4) For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation. > > [5](/bible/psalms/149#v5) Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds. > > [6](/bible/psalms/149#v6) Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand; > > [7](/bible/psalms/149#v7) To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people; > > [8](/bible/psalms/149#v8) To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron; > > [9](/bible/psalms/149#v9) To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the Lord. - Let Israel rejoice in him that made him. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King: who's supposed to be doing the praise dancing? The Israelites, the children of Zion. - Let them praise his name in the dance. - For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: is the Lord taking pleasure in an Apostolic Faith woman dancing a jig? Is the Lord taking pleasure in a COGIC man dancing a jig? The Lord don't hear that garbage. You dancing to Cesare Borgia. It's noise. - He will beautify the meek with salvation: the salvation of the Israelites. - To execute vengeance upon the heathen: we want vengeance for slavery. We want vengeance for the rape that was done to us. We want vengeance for Jim Crow. We want vengeance for black codes. - To bind their kings with chains: that's the prophecy right there. - To execute upon them the judgment written: that's why David was dancing and leaping with joy. Because we going to execute the judgment that's written. ## In Closing *[[25:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0&t=1536s)]* This been 15 minutes with the captains. Praise dancing: we got some edification behind praise dancing. With that, Israel, we going to say shalom. --- [15 Minutes Index](/captains) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcKSW5UDQh0)
